Commentary.Commentary: Right then, that is it from this game and it is England Women who have the headstart in Group B. There is one more game to follow on Super Saturday and it will be a Group A game in which Australia Women take on New Zealand Women beginning at 10.30 pm IST (5 pm GMT) at the same venue. You can switch tabs and follow the build-up to that game. Cheers!

Heather Knight, the captain of England Women says that she is pleased with the effort and feels that it was not the best effort with the ball by them but feels that the attitude with the bat was brilliant. Tells that they had the mindset to play aggressively and they want to entertain. Mentions that this game was a good step in that regard. Mentions that youngsters bring real flair and positivity in the group and it is fun to have them in the group. Informs that they will take the day off, chill and they assess the conditions for the next game.

West Indies Women skipper, Hayley Matthews says that when they were batting in the middle they were looking to get around 145-150. Tells that they couldn’t capitalise in the end after the start they got. Says that she is happy to get runs under belt and get the team off to a good start. Feels that with some seniors back in the team it would help the team massively. States that it is a World Cup and every game is important and it is important to get points on the board and get better.

Natalie Sciver is the PLAYER OF THE MATCH. She says that the pitch was bit tricky to start with and it was two-paced a bit. Tells that she was concentrating on scoring boundaries and needed to take her team over the line. Says the plan from the team was to play aggressive brand of cricket. Feels that for coming matches they need to keep the communication going in the camp and they had some fun in this game and need to keep going.
The Presentation ceremony...

Earlier in the game, Hayley Matthews opted to bat first and this turned out to be the wrong decision as Stafanie Taylor got bogged down at one end. Hayley Matthews and Shemaine Campbelle did play well and laid the platform for the rest of the batters to explode but that wasn't the case. The English bowlers, especially their spinners were able to put on the squeeze and Sophie Ecclestone picked up three wickets in the latter stages to restrict West Indies Women to an under-par total of 135 runs. Coming to the chase, England Women were positive right from the start and even though they lost 3 wickets, the experience and the depth in their batting proved to be crucial and they wre able to get a big win which will help their net run rate a lot.

West Indies Women didn't have many runs to play with but their pacers didn't start off well. Skipper Hayley Matthews then brought herself on early and got peppered by Dunkley. Chinelle Henry was probably the best of the bunch as she got rid of both openers which included a stunning caught and bowled to get rid of Dunkley. All the other bowlers though failed to provide ample support and they succumbed to a fourth consecutive loss in T20Is. They will now look to bounce back strongly in the next game.

With just 136 needed for the win, Sophia Dunkley started aggressively and kept on finding the fence with regularity. Danni Wyatt couldn't stick around for much and neither could Alice Capsey. Dunkley got into the 30s and got out but she had given the headstart England needed. After that the experienced pair of skipper Heather Knight and Natalie Sciver put on a stand of 67 runs and sealed the victory for England.
A pretty straightforward victory in the end for England Women and they get their campaign underway in style. As for West Indies Women, they were completely outplayed in all departments.

SIX! The English skipper finishes things off in style! Lovely shot to end the game. On a length and outside off. Knight makes room, takes a step or two forward and plays a delightful inside-out lofted drive over deep extra cover for a maximum. England Women win by 7 wickets!
A slower fullish delivery on off. Knight works it to the mid on fielder.
Shortish and on off. Sciver pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
WIDE! On a length and way down the leg side. Sciver tries to clip it but misses.
A slower length delivery, outside off. Sciver punches it to sweeper cover for a single. Just a biggie away now, England!
Bowls a yorker on off. Sciver digs it out back to the bowler.
Back of a length, on middle. Knight works it to mid-wicket for a single.
Goes fuller and on off. Sciver drives it to mid on for a single.
A slower length delivery, outside off. Sciver tries to drag it down towards the leg side but misses.
WIDE! A slower fullish delivery and down the leg side. Sciver tries to work it towards the leg side but misses.
A Slower shortish delivery on off. Knight pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
A flatter and quicker delivery on off. Sciver mistimes his drive back to the bowler.
FOUR! In the gap again! Young James bowls it short again on off. Sciver this time pulls it well in front of square for a boundary.
FOUR! Sciver with another lovely shot! Shortish and on middle. Sciver pulls it in the gap through the backward square leg region for a boundary.
Touch shorter and quicker outside off. Sciver chops it towards the point fielder.
Goes fuller and outside off. Sciver tries to sweep it but misses by getting across her stumps. She misses though and gets hit on the pads.
Touch shorter and on middle. Knight works it to square leg for a quick single.
FOUR! Another boundary and just 20 needed now! Bowls an half-tracker on off. Sciver waits for it and slams it over mid on for a boundary.
Shortish and outside off. Sciver slaps it to sweeper cover for a couple.
Flatter and quicker on off. Sciver tries to reverse-sweep it but misses and gets hit on the pads.
Tossed up on off. Sciver tries to slog-sweep it but gets an inside edge onto her pads.
Touch shorter, around off. Sciver punches it to point.
Touch shorter and on middle. Knight works it to mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Boundary to end the over, another expensive one! This is flatter and quicker on leg. Sciver just paddles it away towards the fine leg fence for a boundary.
Touch short of full length on middle and leg. Sciver tries to reverse-sweep it but misses and gets hit on the pads. An appeal follows but the umpire says no.
A fuller delivery on middle. Knight sweeps it to deep square leg for a single.

FOUR! Now, a bit of misfield in the deep allows a boundary. Hayley Matthews is not happy! Touch shorter and on middle. Knight works it through mid-wicket and it is in the gap. The fielder in deep does well to runs towards her left and dive. She gets her hand to it but the ball deflects away for a boundary.
FOUR! Beautifully driven! Overpitched and outside off. Knight drives and drives it crisply through covers for a boundary. 100 up for England Women!

Picthing on off and turning in. Sciver reverse-sweeps it to short third man and takes a quick single. There is a direct hit as well at the batter's end but the replays show that Heather Knight is well in after the leg umpire takes it upstairs.

Drinks break. England are in a hurry to finish this game off. They are playing a very aggressive brand of cricket and though have lost three wickets on the way, the game looks done and dusted here. England are going at a rate of almost 10 and it seems that England would need to collapse dramatically here, if Windies have to win this one. Just 41 runs needed with 10 overs to go. Let’s see how things unfold…
Floated up outside off, this is pushed away with the turn toward cover-point.
Slower through the air, shorter as well and around off, Knight watchfully keeps it out.
FOUR! Well struck! Tossed up on middle and leg, Heather Knight gets under it and whacks it away one-bounce into the wide long on fence.
Loopy delivery, very full on off and dipping on the batter. Natalie Sciver drives it down to long off for a single.
Slower and shorter around off, Knight waits on the back foot and caresses it to sweeper cover for a run.
WIDE! Floated up down the leg side and Heather Knight misses the sweep. A wide is called.
Shorter inj length and on off, Knight advances but just blocks it out.
On middle and leg, knocked down to long on for a single.
FOUR! Nicely done! Flatter again around off stump, Heather Knight goes for the reverse sweep and gets it wide of short third man for a boundary.
This is pushed through a bit fuller on middle, Knight blocks it out.
Keeps it flatter and bowls it around off, Knight eases it off the back foot toward point.
Flatter one on the pads and just sliding on, Knight looks to tuck but misses and wears it on the pads.
Shorter one around off, this is pulled away toward deep mid-wicket for a single.

NO BALL AND SIX! A loosener to start with from the youngster. Zaida James serves a chest-height full toss around middle. Natalie Sciver pulls it all the way over the square leg fence for a maximum. A Free Hit to follow.
Floated up on a length and outside off, Knight stays back and taps it toward point.
Shorter one around off, staying a tad low, Natalie Sciver rocks back and punches it down to long on for one.
A dipping full toss on the pads, Heather Knight works it toward wide long on only for a single.
Flatter one around middle and leg, Heather Knight shuffles across and paddles it 'round the corner for a couple of runs.
Heather Knight is the next batter in.

OUT! STUMPED! Afy Fletcher comes back strongly and gets rid of Alice Capsey. Nicely flighted delivery, on a shorter length and outside off. Capsey comes down the pitch as she looks for the hoick across the line and gets undone in the flight and she doesn't get to the pitch of the ball either. The ball turns away and Capsey ends up just walking past it. Rashada Williams whips off the bails and England Women lose their third wicket.
Commentary.Howout: st Rashada Williams b Afy Fletcher

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Pre-meditated and firmly struck! This is floated up around off stump, Alice Capsey goes for the reverse sweep and nails it past backward point for a boundary.
Afy Fletcher is into the attack now.
Three dots on the trot! Pitches it up on off stump, Natalie Sciver pushes it straight to mid on.
Fullish length around off, Sciver goes for the heave but mistimes it toward mid-wicket.
This is full and on off stumo, Sciver drives it uppishly to mid on.
FOUR! Short ball around off, sitting up nicely for the batter. Natalie Sciver heaves it away through mid-wicket and mid on for another boundary.
FOUR! Classic Natalie Sciver! This is bowled on a length around off, Sciver shuffles across and scoops it over the keeper's head for a boundary.
Back of a length on the body, Alice Capsey walks toward the ball and works it leg side for a single.
Nicely bowled! Slower one, full and around off. Sciver looks to heave it away but is completely undone and after the Powerplay, England Women are firmly in control with the score being 58/2!
TWO WIDES! Full and wide, a bit too wide through and the keeper fumbles the ball as well. They get an extra run.
WIDE! Another slower one, this is on a length and spilled well beyond the tramline outside off. Left alone for a wide.
Slower and shorter outside off, Capsey looks to cut but gets an underedge toward gully.
FOUR! This is picthed up on off stump, Alice Capsey shuffloes across and clubs it down the ground for a boundary.
Full again, Natalie Sciver pushes it to mid on for a single.
Full again around off, Natalie Sciver drives it firmly along the ground and Chinelle Henry makes another sharp stop off her own bowling.
Natalie Sciver is the next batter in.

OUT! CAUGHT AND BOWLED! A ripper of a return catch from Chinelle Henry and she has now got rid of both the England Women openers. Henry bowls it full and around off stump, Sophia Dunkley backs away and drives it firmly back towards the bowler. The drive is uppish and Henry just sticks out a right-hand on the followthrough and pouches it out of thin air. Dunkley cannot believe it but she has to depart after a blistering start. Henry is elated and rightly so.

Wow! Two reviews lost by West Indies Women in the space of a few deliveries and they are out of reviews. Good length around middle and nipping back in. Alice Capsey gets pushed on the back foot as she looks to tuck it away. Capsey misses and gets hit on the pads. There is a huge appeal for lbw but it is turned down. Hayley Matthews does review it and UltraEdge show that there was an inside edge on it.
Slower one, around the top of off, Sophia Dunkley swipes across the line but gets a top edge fine of the fielder at short third man for a single. The 50 is up for England Women.
Very full again and angling into middle and leg, Sophia Dunkley comes forward but only manages to push it toward mid on.

Nicely bowled! Shamilia Connell zones in on the toes and gets in the yorker. Sophia Dunkley looks to jam it out but misses and gets hit on the back leg. Out of nowhere Hayley Matthews goes for the review. There was hardly an appeal from the West Indies Women players. Nothing on UltraEdge and Ball Tracking shows that it is pitching outside leg and the on-field decision stands. A poor review and West Indies Women have lost the review as well.
FOUR! Two in a row now! Shorter and on the body, Sophia Dunkley drags the heave through mid-wicket and picks up a boundary once again.
FOUR! Sophia Dunkley is just keeping on lofting the fuller delivery. This is overpitched on off stump, Dunkley gets under it and lifts it well over mid off for another boundary.
Shamilia Connell is back on. One over for 10 runs so far.

This is very full and wide outside off, close to the tramline. Alice Capsey looks to reach out but fails to get bat on it. There is a sound and there's a stifled appeal for caught behind but the umpire turns it down.
FOUR! Down the pitch and down the ground as well. Pitched up around off, Alice Capsey shuffles across and thumps it right back over the bowler's head for a boundary.
Fullish length around off, Alice Capsey drives it square of the wicket toward backward point.
Alice Capsey walks out at number 3!

OUT! CAUGHT! Straight to the fielder! Chinelle Henry bowls it full and wide, Danni Wyatt gets in position and flat-bats it toward deep cover. The ball pings off her bat but goes right in the bread basket of Chedean Nation in the deep and she takes a sharp catch. Henry is delighted and West Indies Women have the breakthrough they were looking for.
Commentary.Howout: c Chedean Nation b Chinelle Henry

Commentary.Commentary: Pitched up outside off, Dunkely lofts it over wide mid off and gets a single to the deep.
A length ball outside off, Sophia Dunkley advances but the ball keeps low and betas the bat.
Fired in around leg stump, Sophia Dunkley deflects it toward short fine leg for a quick single.
Speared in on the leg stump, Dunkley nudges it leg side.

FOUR! This is excellent batting from Sophia Dunkley, she's playing effortlessly at the moment. Hayley Matthews comes from around the wicket and floats it on middle, Dunkley advances and just plays a checked- drive over the bowler's head for a boundary.
FOUR! Up and over! Tossed up outside off, Sophia Dunkley steps out again and just lofts it over wide mid off for a boundary.
Quicker and flatter around off, this cut away off the back foot and through the cover region for a couple of runs.

SIX! Lovely strike from Sophia Dunkley. Tossed up on a length around middle, Dunkley uses her feet to get to the pitch of the ball before lifting it right back over the bowler's head for a maximum, the first of the match.
Hayley Matthews is into the attack now.
Back of a length over the stumps, this is pulled away in front of mid-wicket for a couple of runs.

FOUR! Streaky boundary! Shofrter and outside off, Danni Wyatt advances and throws her hands at it. The ball goes off the toe end and eludes Hayley Matthews at first slip before running away into the third man fence.
WIDE! This one is pushed well outside the off stump and shapes further away, a wide is called.
Full and wide outside off, swinging away, Wyatt swings but misses once again.
Shorter in length and pushed well outside off, Wyatt goes chasing after it but misses.
Right in the blockhole around off, Danni Wyatt jams it out behind point.
Bangs it in short first up and over middle, Sophia Dunkley forces the pull shot over wide mid on and races back for the third run.
Shamilia Connell to start from the other end.

FOUR! Clubbed away! Pitched up around off and shaping away, Danni Wyatt stays deep and slaps it wide of the fielder at mid off for a boundary. 9 runs off the first over, a good start for England Women.
Full and outside off, shaping away, Sophia Dunkley advances and pushes it through extra cover for a single.
This is a bit fuller and outside off, Sophia Dunkley drives it through cover for a couple of runs.

Risky single! Good length around off, Danni Wyatt stays back and taps it straight to backward point. They go for the single and luckily for Sophia Dunkley, the fielder there misses her shy at the batter's end.
Good length outside off, Danni Wyatt taps it straight to point.

Edged away! This is pitched up outside off by Chinelle Henry and Sophia Dunkley throws her hands at it. Dunkley gets an outside edge wide of the fielder at first slip and down to third man for a single. England Women are underway!
